targets.query:
from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pan_system" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and r._field == "uptime")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Uptime", _value: float(v: r._value) / 8640000.0 }))

from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pan_hr_processors" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and r._field == "processor_load_pct")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r.device_index == "1" then "MP" else if r.device_index == "2" then "DP" else "CPU " + string(v: r.device_index) }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

panels.title: CPU MP / DP
panels.description: Processor load exposed by Palo Alto HOST-RESOURCES SNMP table. On small appliances this usually maps to Management Plane and Data Plane; larger platforms may expose more processor entries.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pan_system" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and r._field =~ /^ram_(total|used)_kb$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.ram_total_kb and exists r.ram_used_kb and r.ram_total_kb > 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "RAM", _value: float(v: r.ram_used_kb) / float(v: r.ram_total_kb) * 100.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

panels.title: MP RAM Usage
panels.description: Management-plane/system RAM from PAN-OS SNMP counters (pan_system / HOST-RESOURCES). Palo Alto does not expose a separate dataplane RAM percentage through the SNMP counters used by this dashboard.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pan_system" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and (r._field == "sessions_active" or r._field == "sessions_max"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "sessions_active" then "Active Sessions" else "Max Sessions" }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pan_system" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and r._field == "session_utilization_pct")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Session Utilization" }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interfaces" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and exists r.ifName and r.ifName !~ /(?i)^(mgmt|management|aux|hsci|ha($|[0-9-]))/ and r.ifName !~ /\./ and (if exists r.ifType then r.ifType =~ /^(ethernetCsmacd|ethernetCsmacd\(6\)|6)$/ else r.ifName =~ /(?i)^(ethernet[0-9]+\/[0-9]+(\/[0-9]+)?|port[0-9]+|wan[0-9]*|lan[0-9]*|internal[0-9]*|dmz[0-9]*|x[0-9]+)$/) and (if exists r.ifConnectorPresent then r.ifConnectorPresent =~ /(?i)^(true|true\(1\)|1)$/ else true) and r._field =~ /^ifHC(In|Out)Octets$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 8.0, _field: if r._field == "ifHCInOctets" then "In" else "Out" }))
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interfaces" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and r.ifName == "${interface}" and r._field =~ /^ifHC(In|Out)Octets$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 8.0, _field: if r._field == "ifHCInOctets" then "In" else "Out" }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

panels.title: Throughput ${interface}
panels.description: Repeated automatically for every non-management interface on the selected firewall.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interfaces" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and r.ifName == "${interface}" and r._field =~ /^if(In|Out)(Errors|Discards)$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "ifInErrors" then "In Errors" else if r._field == "ifOutErrors" then "Out Errors" else if r._field == "ifInDiscards" then "In Discards" else "Out Discards" }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

list.definition:
import "array"

ha = from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pan_system" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and (r._field == "ha_mode" or r._field == "ha_state"))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: if (exists r.ha_mode and r.ha_mode == "disabled") or (exists r.ha_state and r.ha_state == "disabled") then "Standalone" else if exists r.ha_mode and exists r.ha_state then r.ha_mode + " / " + r.ha_state else "Standalone" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

union(tables: [array.from(rows: [{_time: time(v: "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"), _value: "Standalone"}]), ha])
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
